goal: bittensor-subnets: find all bittensor subnets via taomarketcap; for each find all marketing information and twitter posts and things said about them and build a comprehensive list of all the accomplishments from each of those subnets
summary: research dossier on every bittensor subnet (marketing, twitter, accomplishments)

tasks.name: research-subnets-1-32
tasks.scopedGoal: Build a comprehensive accomplishments dossier for Bittensor subnets with netuid 1-32. For each subnet, gather: (a) official subnet name, (b) website / GitHub, (c) primary X/Twitter handle, (d) one-line product description, (e) recent accomplishments (product launches, integrations, partnerships, funding, metrics, awards, notable Twitter posts) drawn from taomarketcap.com, taostats.io, official subnet sites, the team's X/Twitter, Substack/Mirror posts, and Bittensor community sources. Output a per-subnet markdown file at `research/subnets/sn-<netuid>-<slug>.md` plus an index entry. Cite sources inline.
acceptance: Every netuid 1..32 has either a populated dossier file or an explicit 'inactive / unclaimed' stub.
Every active subnet entry lists at least 3 cited accomplishments or, if fewer exist, explains why.

tasks.name: aggregate-report
tasks.scopedGoal: Aggregate the four subplanner outputs into a single comprehensive markdown report at `research/bittensor-subnets-accomplishments.md`. Include: (1) executive summary with totals (active/inactive/unclaimed), (2) a sortable table of every subnet (netuid, name, category, twitter, top accomplishment), (3) per-subnet sections with marketing context and accomplishments, (4) a 'most active on Twitter' shortlist, (5) sources list. Preserve all inline citations from the dossiers.
acceptance: Report covers all netuid 1..128 either with a dossier link or an explicit inactive marker.
Sources section enumerates every domain cited.
